# Environment

```{r}
# Packages
packages <- c("tidyverse", "hues", "ggtext")

# Load packages
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE))

# Print environment

Sys.info()

# Themes
source("./lib/consistent_themes.R")
```

# data

```{r}
source("./lib/processed_data_functions.R")
load_processed_data(
  "./data/phylogeny/curated/threshold_profile_data.RDS",
  c(
    "threshold_group_counts",
    "threshold_group_sizes", "threshold_group_size_medians"
  )
)
```

# generate profile ct data

```{r}
stats_long <- threshold_group_counts
```

# generate profile size data

```{r} 
profile_cluster_df <- threshold_group_sizes
median_df <- threshold_group_size_medians
```

# plots

```{r} 
# line plot 1 
stats_long$category <- ifelse(stats_long$metric %in% c("total_cluster_singleton_ct","profile_groups"),"Groups",
                              ifelse(stats_long$metric %in% c("no_cluster","profile_clusters"),"Clusters",
                                     ifelse(stats_long$metric %in% c("not_in_cluster_ct","profile_singletons"),"Singletons",NA)))
stats_long$type <- ifelse(stats_long$metric %in% c("total_cluster_singleton_ct","no_cluster","not_in_cluster_ct"),"AA-based clustering","AA+Trait-based clustering")
stats_long$category <- factor(stats_long$category,levels = c("Groups","Clusters","Singletons"))

lp1 <- ggplot(stats_long, aes(x = threshold, y = count, colour = type)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.75) +
  scale_y_log10() +  scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "blue"),name = "") +
 geom_vline(xintercept=350, linetype="dashed", color = "red") + 
  labs(x = "Amino acid (AA) distance threshold", y = "Count") +
  theme_bw_me_large + theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black")
) +  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(25,250,500,1000,1500),limits = c(20,1550))  + facet_grid(~category)

lp1
```


# Boxplot size

```{r}
B <- ggplot(data = profile_cluster_df, aes(x = factor(threshold), y = size, fill = type)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(group = interaction(threshold, type)),outlier.size = 0.5) +
    theme_bw_me_large +
    geom_line(data = median_df, aes(x = factor(threshold), y = median_size, color = type, group = type), linewidth = 1.75) +
    xlab("Amino acid (AA) distance threshold") +
    ylab("Group size") +
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = c(25, 250, 500, 1000, 1500),expand = expansion(add =2 )) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("red", "blue"), name = "") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "blue"), name = "") +
    theme(legend.position = 'none',
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 12, color = "black")
    ) + facet_grid(~type) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0)

B
```

```{r,fig.width=8,fig.height=8}
figure <- cowplot::plot_grid(lp1  + theme(legend.position = 'none'), B, ncol=1,labels = "AUTO",rel_heights = c(0.75,1))
figure
```

```{r}
ggsave(filename = "./figures/s_figure_1_group_statistics.png", plot=figure, dpi=600, width = 8, height=8, bg='white')
```
